lines.japanese:
紅緒あずさがいつも草原にいることを忍が知った
のは、週に一度の通院を三度繰り返した頃だった。
lines.english: Shinobu realized that Azusa Benio was always in the meadow around his third weekly trip to the doctor.

lines.japanese:
引っ越し三週間目。
　学校での生活も同じだけ。
lines.english: Three weeks since the move. Three weeks of school, too.

lines.japanese: 慣れ……すなわち日常化。
lines.english: Familiarity... in other words, becoming routine.

lines.japanese:
寡黙で優等生でも劣等生でもない少年が、学期途
中から教室の片隅に加わるという比較的物珍しい
イベントも、すでに鮮度を失って久しい。
lines.english: A quiet boy, neither an honor student nor at the bottom of the class, had appeared in one corner of the classroom midway through the term. Even that relatively unusual event had long since ceased to be a novelty.

lines.japanese: 相変わらず、友人はできない。
lines.english: He still had no friends.
(...Sigh.)

lines.japanese:
そのことについては内心いろいろと思うところ
のある忍で、ことあるごとに吐息を呑み込む羽目
になっている。
lines.english: Shinobu had all sorts of private thoughts on the subject, and found himself swallowing a sigh at every turn.

lines.japanese: 幼い集団には不思議なローカルルールがあるものだ。
lines.english: Groups of children had strange local rules of their own.

lines.japanese:
三週間友人ができなかったら、だいたいそのまま
である。
lines.english: If you had made no friends after three weeks, things generally stayed that way.

lines.japanese:
人間はグループ化する。
　これは男女とも変わりない。
lines.english: People formed groups. Boys and girls were no different.

lines.japanese:
居場所は早期に見つけねばならず、機会を失えば
孤立してしまう可能性は高い。
lines.english: You had to find your place early. Miss the opportunity and you were likely to end up alone.

lines.japanese:
今の忍がそうだった。
　孤立した人間は、いろいろな節目ごとにターゲッ
トにされる危険性を背負う。
lines.english: That was where Shinobu found himself now. And at every turn, anyone isolated ran the risk of becoming a target.

lines.japanese: そういうものだ。
lines.english: That was how these things worked.

lines.japanese:
唯一残された選択肢は、可能な限り大人しくして
いること、だ。
lines.english: The only option left to him was to keep as quiet and unobtrusive as possible.

lines.japanese:
幸い忍は、生来目立つタイプではない。
　会話なく過ぎる時間にも、慣れた。
lines.english: Fortunately, Shinobu was not conspicuous by nature. He was used to hours passing without a word.

lines.japanese: （こんなものか）
lines.english: (I suppose this is how it is.)

lines.japanese:
引っ越してきてからというもの、考える時間だけ
は増えてしまった。
lines.english: Since moving here, if nothing else, he had found himself with far more time to think.

lines.japanese: 歩いている時、余った意識がそうさせるらしかった。
lines.english: When he walked, the idle part of his mind seemed to set him thinking.

lines.japanese: ショートカットの草原で、忍はあずさとすれ違う。
lines.english: In the meadow he used as a shortcut, Shinobu crossed paths with Azusa.

lines.japanese:
通院曜日は一定しない。
　なのにあずさと出会うのは都合四度目だ。
　つまり彼女は毎日ここにいる可能性がある。
lines.english: His appointments did not fall on a fixed day of the week. Yet this made the fourth time he had encountered Azusa. Which meant she might be here every day.

lines.japanese:
草原で二度目に接触した時、あずさのとった不可
解な行動。
lines.english: Azusa's incomprehensible behavior the second time they met in the meadow.

lines.japanese:
あれ以来、両者の間には皮膜が張られている。
　他者と親愛、いずれにも該当しない象徴する何か。
lines.english: Ever since, a membrane had stretched between them. Something symbolic that was neither otherness nor intimacy.

lines.japanese:
半透明、ゼラチン質の膜。
　うすぼけた向こう側に少女の輪郭が霞み、反対に
こちら側の実体をも曖昧にする。
lines.english: A translucent, gelatinous film. Beyond its dim surface the outline of the girl blurred, while his own substance on this side grew equally indistinct.

lines.japanese:
人間関係における溝とは違うものだ。
　今日も所在なく立ち、牽制するような視線を飛ば
してくる。
lines.english: It was not the gulf one usually spoke of between people. Today again, she stood awkwardly, sending him a look of wary defiance.

lines.japanese: （いつも、睨んでくるな）
lines.english: (She always glares at me.)

lines.japanese: （嫌われているんだか知らないけど……）
lines.english: (I don't know if she hates me, but...)

lines.japanese:
（この場所……もしかするとこの子一人の場所だっ
　たのかもしれない）
lines.english: (Maybe this place... used to belong to her alone.)

lines.japanese: してみれば忍は闖入者だ。
lines.english: If so, Shinobu was the intruder.

lines.japanese: （だけどこっちだって、通らないといけない）
lines.english: (But I have to come through here too.)

lines.japanese: 迂回して正規ルートから行くことも出来た。
lines.english: He could have gone around and taken the proper route.

lines.japanese:
なぜか忍はそうしなかった。
　忍が立ち去るまで、決して厳めしい表情を崩さない。
lines.english: For some reason, Shinobu never did. And until he had gone, her forbidding expression never softened.

lines.japanese:
以前のように、何か仕掛けてくることもない。
　忍が歩き。
　あずさが睨み続ける。
lines.english: Nor did she try anything, as she had before. Shinobu walked. Azusa kept glaring.

lines.japanese:
週に一度。
　時には医療上の関係で週に二度や三度ということ
もあったが。
lines.english: Once a week. Sometimes twice or three times, when his medical care required it.

lines.japanese:
あずさはいつも佇んでいたものだ。
　忍が外世界でそうだったように、この奇妙なすれ
違いもまた、二人にとっての日常と化していく。
lines.english: Azusa was always standing there. Just as life in the outside world had become routine for Shinobu, these strange encounters became routine for them both.

lines.japanese: 連綿と。
lines.english: On and on.

lines.japanese: 綿々と。
lines.english: Week after week.

lines.japanese: 積み重なっていった―――
lines.english: Layer upon layer—

lines.japanese:
いつしか、少女の顔から険は薄れていく。
　怒りの風化か、憎悪の霧散か。
lines.english: Before long, the hardness began to fade from the girl's face. Anger weathering away, or hatred dispersing?

lines.japanese: ただ虚実の膜の向こうにあるものを、見守るような。
lines.english: As though she were merely watching whatever lay beyond that membrane of truth and illusion.

lines.japanese:
柔和な他者性が、そこに形成されていった。
　ただの一度も、対話することなく。
lines.english: A gentle otherness took shape there. Without a single word ever passing between them.

lines.japanese:
それは風化でも霧散でもなかった。
　ましてや氷解でもない。
lines.english: It was neither weathering nor dispersal. Still less was it a thaw.

lines.japanese:
相手の個性や歪み、嫌悪の材料などは別次元のこ
ととなっているに過ぎない。
lines.english: The other's personality and distortions—the raw material of dislike— had merely receded into another dimension.

lines.japanese:
ただ過ぎ去り往く相手を……否定するための強い
動機が保てない。
lines.english: There was simply no powerful impulse left to reject... someone who did no more than pass by.

lines.japanese:
優しく触れる方法を、知らなかっただけなのだ。
　噛まれたことしかない子猫は、噛みつく以外の接
触を学ばないはずだ。
lines.english: She simply did not know how to touch gently. A kitten that had only ever been bitten could hardly learn any touch but biting.

lines.japanese:
あずさは見続けた。
　触れず話さずただ、注ぎ続けた。
lines.english: Azusa kept watching. Never touching, never speaking—only pouring her gaze into him.

lines.japanese: 自然な有り様になったのだ―――
lines.english: It became the natural way of things—

lines.japanese: 「……くちんッ」
lines.english: “...Achoo!”

lines.japanese:
一度だけ足を止めて、あずさを見たことがあった。
　少女は鼻をこすって恥ずかしげに顔を伏せた。
　意味はない。
lines.english: Once, Shinobu stopped and looked at Azusa. The girl rubbed her nose and ducked her head in embarrassment. It meant nothing.

lines.japanese:
いつも見る側のあずさだ。
　真正面から見られたことが初めてであったと、た
だそれだけのことだった。
lines.english: Azusa was always the one who watched. It was simply the first time he had looked her full in the face— nothing more.

lines.japanese: そして―――
lines.english: And then—

lines.japanese: その日、紅緒あずさはいなかった。
lines.english: That day, Azusa Benio was not there.

lines.japanese:
胸騒ぎがした。
　いないだけ。
　騒ぐことではない。
lines.english: A sense of foreboding came over him. She simply was not there. That was no cause for alarm.

lines.japanese:
錐のような直感。
　心に持続する苦痛を与える。
　解決しろ。そう命じる。
lines.english: An intuition sharp as the point of an awl. It drove a steady pain into his mind. Resolve this, it commanded.

lines.japanese:
少しは迷っていたのかも知れない。
　やがてつま先を切り返した。三割り増しの速度で。
lines.english: Perhaps he hesitated for a moment. Then he pivoted and retraced his steps—thirty percent faster.

lines.japanese:
言葉がない。
　草に包まれて寝ているのは見たことがある。
lines.english: He had no words. He had seen her asleep amid the grass.

lines.japanese:
しかし土の上に直接、寝息を立てているのは忍の
常識にない行為だ。
lines.english: But lying directly on the dirt, breathing in her sleep, did not fit Shinobu's idea of normal behavior.

lines.japanese:
少女の胸は薄く上下していた。
　シャツに赤土が染みて、夕日の赤でもかき消せな
いほど色づいている。
lines.english: The girl's chest rose and fell shallowly. Red earth stained her shirt, so deeply that even the scarlet sunset could not hide it.

lines.japanese: （でも……良かった）
lines.english: (But... thank goodness.)

lines.japanese:
ほっとしていた。
　複雑な心境だった。
lines.english: He was relieved. His feelings were complicated.

lines.japanese:
今まで暗黙の不可侵状態だった相手を、心配して
しまったのだ。
lines.english: He had worried about someone with whom he shared an unspoken agreement not to interfere with each other.

lines.japanese:
いないものとして扱っていた面が、あったかも知
れない。
lines.english: Perhaps some part of him had treated her as though she did not exist.

lines.japanese:
あずさは刺々しかったし、最近は大人しかったと
はいえ……あんなことがあったのだから。
lines.english: Azusa had always been prickly, and though she had quieted lately... there was what had happened before.

lines.japanese: だけど今、忍は認めざるを得ない。
lines.english: But now, Shinobu had no choice but to admit it.

lines.japanese: （……心配……心配したんだ……きっと）
lines.english: (...Worried... I was worried about her... I think.)

lines.japanese: （この気持ち、ほっとけないって気持ち）
lines.english: (This feeling... that I can't leave her alone.)

lines.japanese: （だってこの子、危なっかしい）
lines.english: (Because this girl always looks like she's about to get hurt.)

lines.japanese: （誰かそばにいてやらないとダメなんだ）
lines.english: (Someone has to stay with her.)

lines.japanese: だけど、とためらいもする。
lines.english: But still, he hesitated.

lines.japanese: （友達なんていないのに）
lines.english: (I don't even have any friends.)

lines.japanese:
（……そんな人間なのに、うまくやっていけるのか
　な？）
lines.english: (...Can someone like me really get along with her?)

lines.japanese:
（傷つけたりしないかな。ぎこちなくなったり、し
　ないかな……？）
lines.english: (What if I hurt her? What if it gets awkward between us...?)

lines.japanese:
触れるのが怖い。
　自分の攻撃力が、相手の防御力が、こわい。
lines.english: He was afraid to touch. His own attack power frightened him. So did her defense power.

lines.japanese:
手の中で壊れたりしないで欲しい。
　壊れる様を見るのは、もうたくさんなのだから。
lines.english: He did not want her to break in his hands. He had already seen enough things break.

lines.japanese:
複雑な気持ち。入り組んだ心。
　絡む情操。交錯する意志。
　やがて、忍は決心をした。
lines.english: Tangled feelings. A labyrinth of a heart. Entwined affections. Conflicting desires. At last, Shinobu made his decision.

lines.japanese:
まぶたが震えて、開いた。
　あずさの、稚気横溢したどんぐりの眼。
lines.english: Her eyelids trembled open. Azusa's acorn-round eyes, brimming with childish vitality.

lines.japanese: 忍は後に、樋口章二に対してこのときのことを、
lines.english: Later, Shinobu would tell Shouji Higuchi about that moment:

lines.japanese:
「その瞬間、頭を拳固で軽く殴ってバカって言いた
　くなった。ちっとも親しくなかったのに」
lines.english: “Right then, I wanted to rap her lightly on the head and call her an idiot. We weren't even close.”

lines.japanese: などと語ることになる。
lines.english: That was how he would describe it.

lines.japanese:
その章二も次の瞬間には、したり顔で頷きながら
当たり前のように煙草を吸おうとしあずさに拳固で
殴られるのだが―――
lines.english: The next instant, that same Shouji would nod sagely and reach for a cigarette as though it were the most natural thing in the world—only to have Azusa rap him on the head.

lines.japanese:
立ちつくす忍と、寝そべっているあずさ。
　夕日がいやましに二人を襲い、顔色もわからぬほ
どに緋色を投げかける。
lines.english: Shinobu stood over Azusa as she lay upon the earth. The deepening sunset bore down on them both, casting such a fierce crimson over them that the color of their faces could not be read.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ……え？」
lines.english: “You... huh?”

lines.japanese: 「……ここで遊ぶのは危ない」
lines.english: “...It's dangerous to play here.”

lines.japanese:
情緒が発達してからなら、もっと温かいことが言
えたのかも知れない。
lines.english: Had his emotional life developed further, perhaps he could have said something warmer.

lines.japanese:
しかし忍はまだ子供で、口をついて出たのも硬質
で抑制された声だった。
lines.english: But Shinobu was still a child, and the voice that came out was hard and restrained.

lines.japanese: 少女を刺激してやまない声でしかなかった。
lines.english: A voice all but guaranteed to put the girl on edge.

lines.japanese: 「あたし……確か……？」
lines.english: “I... I think I was...?”

lines.japanese: 「寝てた」
lines.english: “Asleep.”

lines.japanese: 「あ……そう」
lines.english: “Oh... right.”

lines.japanese: どこか抜けた会話が続く。
lines.english: The strangely disjointed conversation continued.

lines.japanese: 「って、おまえ―――」
lines.english: “Wait, you—”

lines.japanese: 迷った末、あずさは不機嫌そうな顔を作る。
lines.english: After some hesitation, Azusa pulled her face into a scowl.

lines.japanese: 「……あたしのこと、無視するんじゃなかったの？」
lines.english: “...Weren't you going to ignore me?”

lines.japanese:
「怪我でもしてるのかと思った。
　それは見過ごせない」
lines.english: “I thought you might be hurt. I couldn't overlook that.”

lines.japanese:
「するわけないじゃん！
　いっつもここであそんでんのに」
lines.english: “No way! I play here all the time!”

lines.japanese:
「なんでこんなところで寝てたの。
　そこの崖から滑った？」
lines.english: “Then why were you sleeping here? Did you slip down that cliff?”

lines.japanese: 「う……そういえば……あれ？」
lines.english: “Uh... now that you mention it... huh?”

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「なにしてたんだっけ……あたし……」
lines.english: “What was I doing again...?”

lines.japanese: 「僕にきいたって知るはずない」
lines.english: “How would I know?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよそんな言い方！」
lines.english: “You don't have to say it like that!”

lines.japanese:
「……医者に行く予定、サボった。
　叱られるのは僕だ。
　そんな言い方をする権利はある」
lines.english: “...I missed my doctor's appointment. I'm the one who's going to be scolded. That gives me every right to say it like that.”

lines.japanese: 「は、ケンリ？　なに利口ぶってんだか……」
lines.english: “Hah, rights? Look at you, trying to sound so smart...”

lines.japanese: 「え、でも医者ってなに？」
lines.english: “Wait, why do you need a doctor?”

lines.japanese: 「……からだが弱い。だから通ってる」
lines.english: “...I'm not very healthy. That's why I go.”

lines.japanese:
「今日も三時までに行かないといけなかったのに、
　もう五時だ」
lines.english: “I was supposed to be there by three today, and it's already five.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あたしのせいじゃないもん……」
lines.english: “Th-that's not my fault...”

lines.japanese:
声が萎む。
　なにやら忍がただならない犠牲を払ったことを気
取ったのだろう。
lines.english: Her voice dwindled. She must have gathered that Shinobu had made some tremendous sacrifice on her behalf.

lines.japanese: 「今からいけないの？」
lines.english: “Can't you still go now?”

lines.japanese: 「行くけど……怒られる、たぶんね」
lines.english: “I'm going... but I'll probably get in trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「とりあえず、よくわかった」
lines.english: “Well, now I know.”

lines.japanese: 忍は言う。
lines.english: Shinobu went on.

lines.japanese:
苦々しいという感情。
　はじめての、露出。
　自分でも新鮮で、呆れるほど舌もよくまわった。
lines.english: Bitterness. The emotion emerging for the first time. It felt novel even to him, and his tongue moved with astonishing ease.

lines.japanese: 「なにがぁ？」
lines.english: “Know what?”

lines.japanese:
口の端を皮肉げに吊り上げて、言う。
　そんな顔を自然にできたことに、我ながら驚く。
lines.english: He curled one corner of his mouth into a sardonic smile and spoke. That the expression had come so naturally surprised him too.

lines.japanese: 「きみに関わると、ろくなことがないって」
lines.english: “Nothing good ever comes of getting involved with you.”
“What?!”

lines.japanese:
「前のときだって、助けたのにわるものにされるし
　……今回だって何があったのかと思ってさがせば
　……寝てるだけだし」
lines.english: “Last time, I helped you and you treated me like the bad guy ...and this time I came looking because I thought something had happened ...but you were only asleep.”

lines.japanese: 「こんなところで寝たらダメだ」
lines.english: “You shouldn't sleep in a place like this.”

lines.japanese:
「うるさいなー！
　どこで寝たってあたしのかってでしょー！」
lines.english: “Oh, shut up! I can sleep wherever I want!”

lines.japanese: 「服、泥だらけだよ、きみ」
lines.english: “Your clothes are covered in mud, you know.”
“Oh... crap...”

lines.japanese: 「まったく、もう」
lines.english: “Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 深々と息を吐き出す。
lines.english: He let out a long, deep breath.

lines.japanese: 「うー、頭ベリベリする……」
lines.english: “Ugh, my head feels all crackly...”

lines.japanese: 「地べたに頭つけて寝るから」
lines.english: “Because you slept with your head on the ground.”

lines.japanese: 「だって……」
「怪我は？」
lines.english: “Are you hurt?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ないよ。だいじょうび」
lines.english: “Nope. I'm fime.”

lines.japanese: 「痛むところは？」
lines.english: “Does anything hurt?”

lines.japanese: 「ないって」
lines.english: “I said no.”

lines.japanese: 「……吐き気は？」
lines.english: “...Any nausea?”

lines.japanese: 「もー、ないってんだろー！　しっこい！」
lines.english: “I said no! Quit bugging me!”

lines.japanese: 「なら、いい」
lines.english: “Then that’s all right.”

lines.japanese: 忍は元来た道を戻る。
lines.english: Shinobu turned back the way he had come.

lines.japanese: 「あ、どうするの？」
lines.english: “Huh? Where are you going?”

lines.japanese: 「医者に行くよ。言い訳しないと」
lines.english: “To the doctor. I have to explain myself.”

lines.japanese:
「それと、滑った時に頭でもうったのなら一応、
　親御さんに話した方がいい」
lines.english: “And if you hit your head when you fell, you should probably tell your parents, just in case.”

lines.japanese: 「土だから、平気だと思うけど」
lines.english: “You landed on dirt, so I think you'll be all right.”

lines.japanese: 「滑ったんじゃないよぅ……」
lines.english: “I didn't slip...”
“—Bye.”

lines.japanese: 結びの言葉を投げて、忍は歩き出した。
lines.english: Shinobu tossed the parting word over his shoulder and began to walk.

lines.japanese:
あずさが追いすがってくるかと思ったが杞憂らしい。
　その代わり、声がかかった。
lines.english: He had worried that Azusa might run after him, but apparently there was no need. Her voice followed him instead.

lines.japanese: 「ねー！」
lines.english: “Hey!”

lines.japanese: 振り返る。
lines.english: He turned.

lines.japanese: 「これって、助けられたってことー？」
lines.english: “So does this mean you saved me?”
“...Who knows!”

lines.japanese:
本当にわからない。
　忍には、わからないのだ。
lines.english: He truly did not know. Shinobu did not understand.

lines.japanese:
歩く少年の中には、今だかつて感じたことのない
ものが、ゆるゆるといつまでも渦を作っていた。
lines.english: Inside the walking boy, something he had never felt before slowly turned and turned without end.

lines.japanese:
胸が弾けそうな、極度の緊張に似たそれは鮮烈な
までの彩り。
lines.english: Like an unbearable tension that might burst his chest, it burned with a vivid color all its own.

lines.japanese: つよい黄昏のようでもあった。
lines.english: It was like a fierce twilight.
